description: Hold one time with one psychologist (for 30 minutes, and never later than 15 minutes before the session) and return a single-use pay link for the customer. Call check_availability first and use one of its times. Collect the customer's name, phone (with country code) and email first. Couples: also partner_2 (their own name and email or phone; each partner signs their own consent form before the first joint session). Teen (13 to 17): the contact is the parent or guardian, who pays and signs the teen consent form; also give teen_name. The price is set by ElloMind; you cannot set an amount. Plans: plan4, plan8 or plan12 (see list_services). Limits: at most 3 unpaid drafts per phone at a time (cancel_booking_draft frees one) and 8 new drafts per hour from one network.

name.description: the contact: the client, or for teen sessions the parent or guardian

plan_code.description: 'single' for one session; 'plan4', 'plan8' or 'plan12' for a plan (see list_services)

psychologist.description: ONLY if the customer asked for a specific psychologist, the same name used in check_availability

teen_name.description: teen only: the young person's name
